parameters.name: num_periods
parameters.description: Number of periods in the planning horizon

parameters.name: num_products
parameters.description: Number of products in the planning problem

parameters.name: initial_inventory
parameters.description: Initial on-hand inventory for each product

parameters.name: warehouse_capacity
parameters.description: Maximum total inventory that can be held in storage at any time

parameters.name: purchase_price
parameters.description: Unit purchase cost for each product-period pair

parameters.name: selling_price
parameters.description: Unit selling revenue for each product-period pair

parameters.name: optional_demand_cap
parameters.description: Optional exogenous sales cap for each product-period pair, when provided

variables.name: purchase_quantity
variables.description: Purchase quantity for each product at the beginning of each period

variables.name: sales_quantity
variables.description: Sales quantity for each product during each period

variables.name: ending_inventory
variables.description: Ending inventory for each product after each period

variables.name: total_net_revenue
variables.description: Total net financial return over the planning horizon

constraints.name: nonnegative_decision_variables
constraints.description: Purchase quantities, sales quantities, and ending inventories are nonnegative continuous amounts

constraints.name: inventory_capacity_limit
constraints.description: Total inventory stored in any period cannot exceed warehouse capacity

constraints.name: optional_sales_cap
constraints.description: Sales in each product-period may not exceed the optional exogenous demand cap when it is provided

constraints.name: inventory_flow_consistency
constraints.description: Purchases occur at the beginning of each period, sales occur during the period, and unsold inventory carries forward to the next period through inventory balance
constraints.formula: s_{p,t} = I^0_p + x_{p,t} - y_{p,t} \quad \forall p \in \mathcal{P},\; \forall t \in \mathcal{T}

constraints.name: end_inventory_nonnegative
constraints.description: Ending inventory for each product must remain nonnegative in every period

objectives.name: total_net_revenue_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize total net financial return over the planning horizon, represented by total_net_revenue

final_objective.description: Maximize total net financial return over the planning horizon by maximizing total_net_revenue.
